gate_decisions.reason: The locked-P000 translation/Folner transfer question is terminally answered by an exact authorization no-go, finite action underdetermination witnesses, and a conditional classical reuse interface. Choosing a native translation action would require independently justified new semantics under a new objective.
No native action has been accepted, so there is no stable native action/Folner theorem interface to formalize yet.
Classical finite-group amenability and Folner averaging are explicitly separated as conditional reuse and receive no novelty claim.
The finite nonconjugacy and group-action witnesses are exhaustively checked by the deterministic certificate.
Translation authorization, action typing, period/window requirements and conditional density reuse are integrated in one typed boundary; no new general tool is introduced.
The review rejects coordinate, automorphism, finite-permutation and comparison-model shortcuts and independently verifies all manifest blobs.
